text: BiasAperture 20-track research board (task_2026-08-22_002): constraint — no git commit/push to the repo from any of the 20 users until all 20 child tracks (task_2026-08-22_003..022) are done. Each user works in their local clone, saves output to research/results/XX_*.md, and holds it uncommitted. Single consolidated commit/push happens only after the full board is done, to avoid mid-sprint drift on the shared CONTEXT.md ground truth.
